name: smwgraphics-virtua-racing-deluxe-big-forest
title: Virtua Racing Deluxe - Big Forest
description:
Ripped from Big Forest in Virtua Racing Deluxe on Sega 32x. This rip was part of my C3 Graphic Ripping Showcase.

Note: This background has been used only with the Layer 2 Editing Mode, because it can't be completed by trying to put it with the Background Layer 2 Editor. Meant to be used with a Layer 2 level.
